title: DISCERN: Decoding Systematic Errors in Natural Language for Text Classifiers

bias_targets.target: Systematic bias (Annotation artifacts and sub-population underperformance)
bias_targets.methodology: Clustering validation set examples where the text classifier exhibits high misclassification rates, using an Explainer LLM to generate natural language descriptions (predicates) of the shared semantic features of these clusters, and measuring classifier performance improvements after data augmentation.

primary_bias_target: Systematic bias (Annotation artifacts and sub-population underperformance)
